ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 88
   B. 22
   C. 38
   D. 19

4. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

5. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

6. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 23
   D. 120

7. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 1, 6
   B. 2, 4, 6
   C. 1, 2, 3, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. Solve for x: x + 4 = 16. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 12

10. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

11. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 90

13. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

14. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 1000 m²

15. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23
   C. 23.7
   D. 29

17. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

18. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 49
   C. 24.5
   D. 7

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

20. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

21. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 29
   C. 28
   D. 3

22. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 48
   D. 14

23. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

24. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 26
   C. 5
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
